related.title: Explore Jammu & Kashmir
related.note: Jammu & Kashmir is the kind of place that stays with you long after the trip ends. It has snow-capped Himalayan peaks, saffron fields in bloom and quiet mornings on a Dal Lake shikara, with steam rising off a cup of kahwa. In Srinagar you can stay on a carved-wood houseboat and stroll through the Mughal Gardens. Gulmarg offers a Gondola ride over snow meadows and some of Asia’s best skiing. Pahalgam and Sonmarg bring rushing rivers, Betaab Valley and glacier views. Jammu adds its own warmth, with the sacred Vaishno Devi shrine, Patnitop’s pine hills and the festive aroma of Wazwan. Whether you come for a honeymoon, a family holiday or a peaceful break, every season here has its own magic, from spring tulips and summer meadows to golden autumn and white winter.

faqSubheading: We help you prepare for your trip and answer all your travel questions.

faqs.question: Which places are covered in Jammu Kashmir tour packages?
faqs.answer: Our Jammu-Kashmir tour packages cover the best of the valley: Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam and Sonmarg, with Jammu added on selected itineraries. Along the way you will see Dal Lake, the Mughal Gardens, the Gulmarg Gondola, Betaab Valley and the Sonmarg meadows.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Kashmir?
faqs.answer: April to October is the most pleasant time for sightseeing, with blooming gardens, green meadows and clear mountain views. If you dream of snow, Gulmarg and Sonmarg look their best from December to February.

faqs.question: Is a houseboat stay included in Kashmir tour packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, most of our Srinagar itineraries include a houseboat stay on Dal Lake, along with a Shikara ride at sunset. It is the most memorable way to experience Kashmir’s lake life, and many guests say it was the highlight of their trip.

faqs.question: What is included in a Kashmir tour package?
faqs.answer: Our Kashmir holiday packages typically cover hotel or houseboat accommodation, selected meals, sightseeing, comfortable on-tour transport and tour manager support. Inclusions vary by package, so check the itinerary before you book.

faqs.question: Are Kashmir tours suitable for families, couples and senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our Jammu-Kashmir packages include family holidays, couple trips, group departures and special tours for women and senior citizens, all with a comfortable, well-paced itinerary. We can also customize a plan to suit your dates and interests.
